messages.version_too_old: This version is no longer supported. Please update to the latest version from TestFlight.
messages.build_disabled: This test build has been disabled. Please download build 21 or newer from TestFlight.

comments: 1. Any app version below 1.1 is automatically killed (via min_required_version)
2. For version 1.1, only builds listed in the whitelist array are allowed to run
3. To disable a build: remove its number from the whitelist
4. To enable a new build: add its number to the appropriate version's whitelist
5. To kill an entire version: remove it from whitelist or update min_required_version
